title: Loyalty Card Data Segment
applicability: Required in every Loyalty Card Transaction Request; exclusive to that message family (not a Financial Transaction Request companion).
scopeNote: Full-catalog baseline: mirrors all 24 rules in docs/specs/kb/segment-108/coverage/segment-108-rule-catalog.json (structure, applicability, field, serialization, compatibility, lifecycle, and metadata classes).

businessRequirements.title: Segment 108 belongs exclusively to the Loyalty Card Transaction Request; it is not a Financial Transaction Request companion
Segment 108 is required in every Loyalty Card Transaction Request
Segment Type is 108
Segment Length is 3 digits representing the segment content length
Segment 108 maximum length is 142 alphanumeric characters
Field order matches Section 12.7 (fields 12-13 are element 148 then element 147, not ascending element-number order)
All fields are separated by Field Separators, including a separator following the last field
Loyalty Program ID, required, is numeric with maximum length 6
Loyalty Account Number, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 24
Points to Redeem, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 6
Coupon ID, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 19
Coupon Amount, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 8
Update Code, when populated, is exactly one alphanumeric character from the documented set A, C, E, I, P, S, T, U
Street Address, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 5
Phone Number, Loyalty, when populated, is numeric with maximum length 10
Expiration Date is reserved for future use; the validator does not enforce a format even when the field is populated
Payment Tender Type is required, exactly 2 alphanumeric characters from the documented set
Loyalty Track 2 Data, when populated, is alphanumeric with maximum length 38
Loyalty Information Version, when populated, is numeric length 1 with valid values 1 or 2; defaults to 1 when not sent
Unit of Work, when populated, is numeric with fixed length 19; required on loyalty reversals to match the original purchase
Segment 108 appears exactly once per message
Segment 108 originates at the device
Segment 108's sole optional Data Section 3 companion is Segment 114 (SKU Data Segment)
Segment 108 does not appear in the Loyalty Card Transaction Response, which mirrors the generic Financial Transaction Response layout

testCases.positive: Loyalty Card Data Segment present exactly once with a Standard Segment sibling
Fields 12-13 serialized as 148 then 147 with trailing separator
negative: Fields 12-13 serialized in ascending element-number order

testCases.positive: All optional numeric/alphanumeric fields within documented length bounds
negative: Each field individually exceeds its documented max length or format
Reversal function with no mapped code (SEG108-SME-002, open)

testCases.positive: Payment Tender Type required and in documented 15-value set
negative: Payment Tender Type outside documented set

testCases.positive: Expiration Date left unenforced; device-origin metadata cataloged
Segment 108 combined only with Segment 100 and optionally Segment 114
negative: Segment 108 combined with a Financial Transaction Request companion (101/102/103/104/111)

testCases.positive: Segment 108 absent from Loyalty Card Transaction Response
negative: Segment 108 present in a response (disputed, unconfirmed scenario, SEG108-SME-003 open)
